provenance: synthetic teaching cases, not runtime observations
capability: owned-object conditional update and bounded watch/relist observer

cases.task: Explain the role of hello-config,u1 and rv-A.
cases.expected: Name addresses an object; UID its lifetime; resourceVersion is an opaque API token.

cases.task: Apply an rv-A update to stored rv-B with the same UID.
Read rv-B and preserve unrelated fields while reconsidering the intended message edit.
cases.expected: A new conditional request uses current state and a bounded retry count.

cases.task: Reread the same name with UID u2 when the lease expected u1.
cases.expected: Refuse the mutation across object replacement.

cases.task: Replace a stale cache with a supplied fresh list after410.
cases.expected: Current u2 snapshot retained; watcher restarts from the new list token.

cases.task: Classify a bookmark and a repeated modified event.
cases.expected: Bookmark advances progress; duplicate state does not repeat external effects.
